title: SXSW Interactive
metaDescription: SXSW Interactive: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Tech Events.

overview.about: SXSW (South by Southwest) is the sprawling Austin festival where technology, film and music collide each March. Its Interactive track made the event a launchpad for digital culture and startups, and the whole festival turns the Texas capital into a global stage for new ideas.
overview.nextEvent: The next SXSW runs in March in Austin, Texas, with the Interactive, Film and Music tracks overlapping across the city. Keynotes, panels and a startup showcase draw a huge international crowd of technologists and creatives.
